hero.heading: Plan trips together, stress-free.
hero.subheading: Wander brings your crew into one place — vote on destinations, split expenses, sync calendars, and let AI handle the heavy lifting.

tripTypes.heading: What kind of adventure are you planning?

local.title: Local Adventure
local.description: Discover hidden gems in your city or nearby. Perfect for weekend getaways and day trips with friends.

overseas.title: Overseas Escape
overseas.description: Plan your dream international trip with everything from flights to local experiences, all in one place.

features.heading: Everything your group needs to plan the perfect trip
features.subheading: From the first idea to the final recap — Wandertogether has every tool your crew needs.

items.title: Collaborative Planning
items.description: Invite your whole crew and plan together in real time. Everyone has a voice.

items.title: Polls & Voting
items.description: Create polls for destinations, activities, or restaurants. Set a time limit and let the votes roll in.

items.title: Expense Tracker
items.description: Track every cost and see exactly what each person owes. Filter by food, flights, hotels, and more.

items.title: AI Trip Assistant
items.description: Get smart suggestions to save time and money. Flag weather issues, events, and trip blockers before they happen.

items.title: Calendar Availability
items.description: Find the best dates for everyone with a When2Meet-style availability grid.

items.title: Trip Memories
items.description: Upload photos and videos during your trip. Get a beautiful post-trip recap when you're back home.

howItWorks.heading: Planning a trip has never been this easy

steps.title: Create your trip

steps.title: Invite your crew
steps.description: Send invites to friends and family. Everyone joins in seconds.

steps.title: Plan together
steps.description: Vote on places, split costs, sync calendars, and let AI optimize the rest.

cta.heading: Your next adventure is one invite away.
